answer: 1. Each identity starts with 1 trust token in its personal vault. 2. A random walk algorithm visits N identities, weighted by vault token counts. 3. After 100 steps, tokens redistribute proportionally to visit frequency. Cost: $3 \times N$ for N identities. Minimum 10,000 initial tokens. Failure: If 51% of tokens are controlled by a Sybil attacker. This mechanism is like a lantern, where the brightest glow (most tokens) guides the path, solidifying the mesa of collective trust.
